keyFindings.description: hubServer.start draws three new ports on any retry (:447-450), also for the restarts in phases (b) :1074, (c) :1125, (e) :1272 and (f) :1320. The exporters' scrape targets (:1090) and the urls snapshot (:851-854) keep the old ports, so a restart that has to retry makes a later assertion fail (awaitLastSeqs at :1127, connectHub(urls[:1]) at :1155). At 253b920c a restart retried on the same ports. Fix: a restart keeps its ports (draw only on the first start), and the comment at :440-444 says why.
Cleanup: loopbackPorts.mu guards a draw that only the test goroutine makes (draw calls require, so it cannot run elsewhere).
